about_the_game:
This is a Touhou fan-made SRPG.

Control the player and win by annihilating the enemy camp.

Players have a variety of abilities, including characters that can exploit various enemy weaknesses and characters that can deal fixed damage.

Use these abilities to defeat your enemies.

Understand enemy behavior patterns and weaknesses, and develop strategies to defeat them!

Each weapon can exploit the weaknesses of each enemy class.

Each character has their own class,

which can be used to expand your tactical options.

◆Story

Sanae and her friends are suddenly transported to another world.

There, a fierce battle for supremacy is being waged between the various royal families...

Sanae and her friends are inevitably drawn into the battle.

Sanae and her friends' adventure to return to their world has begun!

A full-scale SRPG on a grand scale! It's here!

◆Characters

Sanae, Reimu, Sakuya, Remiria, Flandre, Patchouli, Koakuma, Misuzu, Alice, Marisa, Youmu, Yuyuko

Murasaki, Daiou, Ai, Kaguya, Eirin, Tei, Reisen, Cirno, Kanako, Suwako, Suika, Yuuka, Shizuha, Minoru

Rumia, Tenshi, Aya, Nitori, Satori, Koishi, Orin, Sora, Parsee

Kaede, Komachi, Iku, Keine, Mokou, Great Fairy, Hijiri, Nue, Hoshi, Akyuu, Medicine

Kamiki, Mima, Ellie, Kurumi, Yumemi, Chiyuri, Lily White, Yuugi, Nazrin, Murasa

Yumeko, Sara, Mai, Yuki, Shikieiki, Hatate, Louise, Gengetsu, Kasen, Kogasa, Hina, Futo, Mamizou, Rinnosuke

◆Difficulty: Enemy strength changes depending on the difficulty level you select.
